integrity: Analytic proof and standalone 3200 exact rational supplementary comparisons. Scientific conclusions remain subject to independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only real finite character-polynomial masks of the specific SU(2) Abel kernel; no result for heat coefficients or other groups. Older equivalent Chebyshev-positive-type formulas may exist. This includes no independent mathematical validation.
title: Finite positive-type and universality cones for character-polynomial Abel kernels on \(SU(2)\)
